scope: Durable independent-validator Solana V4 vote exchange and runtime-intent binding
issue_fixed: Independently signed Solana votes had no production transport, accepted proofs did not require the signed proof id to match the runtime settlement intent, and the submitter/library aggregation path had no end-to-end test through a real vote service.
implementation: Add a bounded HTTP vote exchange for complete Solana V4 evidence packages.
Authenticate every submission against the configured Solana validator set with strict Ed25519 verification.
Persist accepted votes as JSON with file and parent-directory sync, an atomic temporary-file replacement, and verification of every persisted vote when the store is reopened.

Persist each validator's observed evidence digests for a proof id, refuse a different package without immediately condemning the submitter, and record equivocation only when the history proves one validator signed multiple packages.
Reject a reopened store with duplicate proof ids, unauthorized observations, invalid signatures, or unrecorded multi-digest equivocation.
Make repeated publication idempotent for the same validator and exact evidence package.
Expose health, publish, and query routes plus a reusable client for validator and aggregator processes.
Require the signed V4 proof id to equal the settlement-engine runtime intent id in the relayer submission boundary and the settlement verifier.

Add a real HTTP aggregation test that publishes two independent votes, retrieves them through the client, combines them with the submitter's own vote, and verifies the resulting three-signature Solana proof.

negative_and_boundary_tests: An unauthorized validator key is refused before persistence.
A forged or tampered Ed25519 signature is refused.
A second evidence package for an existing proof id is refused without condemning a validator that has not signed another package.
Submitting the same conflicting package repeatedly remains an evidence conflict rather than becoming equivocation.
A validator that signs both the canonical package and an alternate package is recorded as equivocated and loses its prior vote.
A validator already marked equivocated cannot return with another vote for the same proof id.
A reopened store refuses duplicate proof ids and multi-digest observation history that lacks an equivocation record.
A persisted store is revalidated at open time and refuses unauthorized or invalid persisted votes.
The submitter refuses a signed proof whose proof id differs from the runtime settlement intent.
The settlement engine refuses V4 evidence whose proof id differs from the intent.
limitations: No public Solana RPC or live mainnet-beta transaction was queried in this evidence run.
The HTTP exchange was exercised between local processes; it has not yet been deployed as independent validator and aggregator services.
The standalone x3-relayer executable still needs to be replaced by the library RelayerService.
No external audit, public testnet, or controlled mainnet canary covers this transport.
